name: CloudFront - sanitized manual Create Wait Get

nodes.name: Prepare Request
nodes.notes: One request per manual run. This is not connected to production. Replace placeholders with reviewed non-production values; preserve the same reference and exact paths on retries.

nodes.name: Create Invalidation
nodes.notes: Select your AWS CloudFront API credential. No credentials are embedded in this export. Create acceptance is NOT completion.

nodes.name: Stop - Observation Timeout

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'CloudFront observation deadline exceeded; completion is NOT confirmed. Saved invalidationId=' + ($json.invalidationId ?? 'unavailable') }}

nodes.notes: Timeout is not completion or cancellation. Reconcile the saved invalidation ID later instead of creating a new logical request.

nodes.name: Confirmed Completed
nodes.notes: The only success terminal. Reached only after an AWS response with exact Completed status, before the observation deadline.

nodes.name: Wait Before Poll
nodes.notes: Carries distribution/invalidation IDs, original paths, stable CallerReference and the original absolute deadline. Never resets the deadline.

nodes.name: Get Invalidation
nodes.notes: Select the same AWS CloudFront API credential as Create. Get replaces JSON; Assess restores immutable request state from Prepare and the ID from Create.
